prompts.desktop: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background asset for Cyber Skunk game. Wide 16:9 industrial ventilation hall, premium painted dimensional game art matching reference's dark graphite, midnight steel, aged brass and sparse amber utility lights. No characters, no cabinet, no reels, no symbols, no words or UI. Enormous ventilation fans recessed high in left background, layered ducts and structural beams at far edges, empty floor grill lower left to ground mascot. Middle and right 75% are quiet dark low-contrast wall and floor to sit behind the live game cabinet. Deliberate restrained lighting, handsome tactile materials, no neon rainbow, no fog covering foreground, no busy centre. Full bleed opaque environment, 2560x1440 intended composition.
